summary.text: Catherine Stefani represents California's 19th Assembly District, which encompasses the western neighborhoods of San Francisco and northern San Mateo County.

paragraphs.text: According to her Assembly biography, she previously served as a San Francisco County Supervisor and as a prosecutor with the Contra Costa County District Attorney's Office, and she founded the San Francisco chapter of Moms Demand Action.
She grew up in Merced, California, earned her law degree from McGeorge School of Law, and now lives in San Francisco.
